title: Populate the Graph Context section of every parent issue body

facts.note: GATING fact: the target is the body of an ATDD parent issue (vs. sub-issue, comment, non-ATDD issue). Needs an observer that recognises an ATDD parent issue body being authored or edited; the validator test_issue_body_has_graph_context reads issue bodies, but the agent harness does not yet expose this as a fact.
Any creation or edit of the parent issue body text, regardless of whether the Graph Context section is currently compliant.
NON-GATING hint only: these phrases raise confidence but are not required; an edit to an ATDD parent issue body is in scope even if the task wording contains none of them.

fires: Planner drafts a new ATDD parent issue body.
Planner edits an existing ATDD parent issue body whose Graph Context section is missing.
An ATDD parent issue body still contains the Graph Context injection placeholder instead of real content.
Planner edits any other part of an ATDD parent issue body that already has a populated Graph Context section (in scope; already satisfied as long as the section stays populated).
Task wording does not mention 'Graph Context' or 'parent issue' but the edit targets an ATDD parent issue body.
doesNotFire: Editing a sub-issue, comment, or non-ATDD issue that is not a parent issue body.
Editing plan docs, wagons, WMBTs or acceptances that are not a parent issue body.

given: You are authoring or editing the body of an ATDD parent issue
when: you write or save the issue body
then: The body carries a Graph Context section populated with where the issue sits in the dependency graph — not missing and not left as the injection placeholder.
prefer: Fill the Graph Context subsection with the issue's actual position in the dependency graph before work starts.
avoid: Omitting the Graph Context section from a parent issue body.
Leaving the Graph Context injection placeholder in place of real content.
Filling the section with filler text just to satisfy the validator without stating graph position.
why: A populated Graph Context section forces each issue to state where it sits in the dependency graph before work starts.
evidence: Validator test_issue_body_has_graph_context::test_issue_body_has_graph_context passes for the parent issue body.
Reviewer sees a Graph Context subsection in the parent issue body with non-placeholder content describing its dependency-graph position.
verifier_detail: Term parent_issue_body: the body of an atdd parent issue.
Term graph_context_section: the populated Graph Context subsection of the issue body.
Fail if the Graph Context section is absent OR still equals the injection placeholder.
Severity 3; disposition suppress-and-clean (existing violations may be suppressed but must be cleaned); suppression deadline 2026-12-31.

additions.text: Filling the section with filler text just to satisfy the validator without stating graph position.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming anti-pattern required by authoring rules; follows from 'populated' and the rationale (state where the issue sits in the graph).
